newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Ecuador's monetary base fell 2.15 pct in week.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador's monetary base fell 2.15 pct in week.

text.p: Ecuador's monetary base fell 2.15 percent to 2.72 billion sucres in the week to October 18, the Central Bank said Monday.
The bank did not explain the reasons for the decrease.
In the previous week, the monetary base grew 1.98 percent.
In September, monetary base grew 0.87 percent to 2.56 billion sucres.
The monetary base ended 1995 at 2.41 billion sucres, up from 1.85 billion sucres at the end of 1994.
